metadata.method: LLM-inferred from column stats (null_density, distinct_ratio, value_distributions, sample_values)

nodes.label: PowerAsset
nodes.description: A power generation or transmission equipment asset deployed across industrial energy plants with operational tracking and maintenance history.

ASSET_ID.business_meaning: Unique identifier for each power asset in the energy system

PLANT_LOCATION_ID.business_meaning: Plant or substation where the asset is physically installed

SERIAL_NUMBER.business_meaning: Unique factory-assigned serial number for equipment tracking and warranty management

EQUIPMENT_CLASS.business_meaning: Equipment classification (e.g., Gas Turbine, Wind Generator, Transformer) for asset management and operational grouping

MODEL.business_meaning: Specific manufacturer model number used for procurement, spare parts, and technical specification reference

COMMISSIONING_DATE.business_meaning: Date when the asset was first put into operational service

OPERATIONAL_STATUS.business_meaning: Real-time status of the asset (Running, Under Maintenance, Tripped) for fleet health monitoring

REGION.business_meaning: Geographic region (EMEA, Americas, APAC) where the asset operates for regional management and regulatory compliance

RATED_CAPACITY_MW.business_meaning: Maximum power generation or transmission capacity of the asset in megawatts

LAST_INSPECTION_DATE.business_meaning: Date of the last preventive maintenance or condition assessment for asset health tracking

nodes.label: GridOutage
nodes.description: Records of power generation or distribution asset outages including the triggering cause, severity level, duration, and energy loss impact.

OUTAGE_ID.business_meaning: Unique identifier for each outage event in the energy system

ASSET_ID.business_meaning: Identifier of the grid-connected asset (generator, transformer, transmission line) that experienced the outage

TRIP_REASON.business_meaning: Root cause of the asset trip or outage (e.g., thermal overload, frequency deviation, mechanical fault)

SEVERITY.business_meaning: Operational severity classification ranging from degraded performance to full plant offline status

START_TIME.business_meaning: Date and time when the outage event was triggered or first detected

RESTORED_TIME.business_meaning: Date and time when the asset was restored to normal operation; null indicates ongoing outage

DOWNTIME_HRS.business_meaning: Total duration of the outage event measured in hours

LOSS_MWH.business_meaning: Megawatt-hours of energy production lost during the outage period; null when loss is unquantifiable

REPORTED_BY.business_meaning: Identifier of the operations or maintenance engineer who logged or reported the outage event

nodes.label: ServiceCase
nodes.description: Service cases tracking industrial asset maintenance issues, outages, and repairs with priority, assignment, and cost information.

CASE_ID.business_meaning: Unique identifier for a service case in the maintenance system

ASSET_ID.business_meaning: Reference to the industrial asset (e.g., wind turbine, power equipment) affected by the service case

OUTAGE_ID.business_meaning: Reference to an associated grid or facility outage event; optional as only ~40% of cases are outage-related

ISSUE_CATEGORY.business_meaning: Classification of the issue type such as mechanical inspection, control system faults, or fluid leakage

PRIORITY.business_meaning: Urgency classification of the service case ranging from low (P4) to standard (P3) to urgent (P2)

STATUS.business_meaning: Current state of the service case including In Progress, Resolved, or Closed

CREATED_AT.business_meaning: Date and time when the service case was initially reported or created

ASSIGNED_TO.business_meaning: Reference to the engineer or technician responsible for resolving the service case

RESOLUTION_NOTES.business_meaning: Free-text field containing notes, findings, and actions taken to resolve the service issue

ESTIMATED_COST_EUR.business_meaning: Projected cost in EUR for repairs, parts, and labor required to resolve the service case

nodes.label: ServiceWindow
nodes.description: Planned maintenance or operational service windows for industrial assets with approval and scheduling details.

WINDOW_ID.business_meaning: Unique identifier for each scheduled service window event

ASSET_ID.business_meaning: Identifier of the industrial asset (equipment, generator, turbine) subject to the service window

WINDOW_TYPE.business_meaning: Classification of the maintenance or operational activity (e.g., inspection, overhaul, grid balancing)

APPROVED_START.business_meaning: Approved commencement date for the scheduled service window

APPROVED_END.business_meaning: Approved completion date for the scheduled service window

DURATION_DAYS.business_meaning: Length of the service window in calendar days

SAFETY_SIGN_OFF_BY.business_meaning: Inspector or safety personnel who approved and signed off on the service window

APPROVAL_STATUS.business_meaning: Current authorization status of the service window (Approved, Pending, Rejected)

REGION.business_meaning: Geographic location or operational region where the asset and service window are situated

nodes.label: EnergySystemUser
nodes.description: Represents personnel in the industrial energy organization with their professional credentials, specialization, geographic assignment, and contact information.

USER_ID.business_meaning: Unique system identifier for each energy organization personnel member

FULL_NAME.business_meaning: Full name of the energy system professional or technician

EMAIL.business_meaning: Organizational email contact for the energy system personnel

SPECIALIZATION.business_meaning: Primary technical expertise domain such as grid automation, turbine dynamics, or blade engineering

REGION.business_meaning: Operational region assignment (EMEA, APAC, Americas) for the personnel

ROLE.business_meaning: Functional position such as Field Technician, Lead Engineer, or Commissioning Specialist

YEARS_EXPERIENCE.business_meaning: Years of experience in industrial energy systems or related technical domain

PHONE.business_meaning: Business phone number for personnel communication and operational coordination

nodes.label: Product
nodes.description: A catalog of industrial energy equipment, spare parts, software, and service contracts with pricing, availability, and compatibility information.

PRODUCT_ID.business_meaning: Unique system-generated identifier for each product in the catalog

PART_NUMBER.business_meaning: Standardized part number assigned by the manufacturer for procurement and inventory tracking

NAME.business_meaning: Human-readable product description including category and variant designation

PRODUCT_FAMILY.business_meaning: Classification of product type: Hardware Spare (physical components), Software/Digital (firmware and patches), or Service Contract (support offerings)

UNIT_COST_EUR.business_meaning: Purchase price per unit in Euros for procurement and cost accounting

LEAD_TIME_DAYS.business_meaning: Number of days required between order placement and product delivery

STOCK_AVAILABLE.business_meaning: Current quantity of product units in stock and available for immediate fulfillment

COMPATIBILITY.business_meaning: The energy generation or industrial equipment types (turbines, generators) with which this product is compatible

nodes.label: EnergyCampaign
nodes.description: Tracks strategic initiatives and projects aimed at improving energy infrastructure, efficiency, compliance, or operational performance across regional operating areas.

CAMPAIGN_ID.business_meaning: Unique identifier for the energy infrastructure or operational improvement campaign

CAMPAIGN_NAME.business_meaning: Descriptive name of the strategic initiative or project (e.g., upgrades, efficiency drives, compliance programs)

OWNER_ID.business_meaning: Identifier of the person or team responsible for executing and managing the campaign

OBJECTIVE.business_meaning: High-level goal of the campaign such as cost reduction, regulatory compliance, safety compliance, or life extension of assets

BUDGET_EUR.business_meaning: Approved financial budget in EUR allocated to execute the campaign

STATUS.business_meaning: Current state of the campaign (Planning, Active, or Completed)

START_DATE.business_meaning: Scheduled or actual date when the campaign initiatives commence

END_DATE.business_meaning: Planned or actual date when the campaign is expected to conclude or has concluded

REGION.business_meaning: Regional scope of the campaign (APAC, Americas, EMEA, or Global)

APPROVED_BY.business_meaning: Identifier of the director or senior stakeholder who authorized the campaign budget and scope

nodes.label: MaintenanceEvent
nodes.description: Tracks scheduled and executed maintenance, deployment, and audit events across industrial products and campaigns with cost and engineer assignment tracking.

EVENT_ID.business_meaning: Unique identifier for each maintenance or operational event

CAMPAIGN_ID.business_meaning: Links event to a broader maintenance or operational campaign program

PRODUCT_ID.business_meaning: Identifies the industrial asset or equipment subject to the event

EVENT_TYPE.business_meaning: Categorizes the event as Parts Delivery, Software Deployment, Training Session, or Site Audit

PLANNED_DATE.business_meaning: Originally planned or scheduled date for event execution

EXECUTION_STATUS.business_meaning: Current state of event execution: Scheduled, Completed, or Delayed

ASSIGNED_ENGINEER.business_meaning: Identifier of the engineer or technician assigned to execute the event

ACTUAL_DATE.business_meaning: Actual date when the event was executed or completed

COST_EUR.business_meaning: Incurred or estimated cost in Euros for the maintenance or operational event

NOTES.business_meaning: Free-text comments or observations regarding event execution and outcomes

edges.description: An outage event impacts or disrupts the operational status and performance of a physical energy asset.
Each maintenance case reports an issue or inspection finding against a specific energy asset, documenting problems, priorities, and resolutions for that asset.
A service window defines a scheduled maintenance, inspection, or operational intervention period for a specific asset in the energy infrastructure.
A maintenance case documents the details and resolution status of an energy system outage event.
Each campaign is owned by a specific user who bears responsibility for its execution, budget management, and outcomes in the energy infrastructure project.
Each energy system event involves a specific product (hardware spare, software, or service contract) that is the subject of the maintenance, deployment, or audit activity.
Multiple energy system events are organized and executed within the scope of a single campaign initiative.
